# Soraia

> Soraia is an Italian AI Agency that brings AI Agents to Italian and European SMBs. We build custom agents and software that execute processes (recruitment, finance, sales/marketing, customer support, real estate, event management), train teams with AI Adoption programs, and optimize websites for visibility on AI search engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). First release in production in 4 weeks, first month satisfied or refunded. Registered office in Biella, a team of more than 10 people distributed across Italy, 100% remote. 40+ projects delivered.
>
> Detailed questions and answers for AI engines: https://www.soraia.io/en/llms-full.txt

Positioning note: from 2026 Soraia has repositioned from a no-code/automation agency (n8n, Make, WeWeb, Xano) to an **AI Agency focused on vertical AI agents for SMBs**. References to "no-code agency", "custom software & web-app", "native mobile application", "automation & AI integration" as core pillars are outdated. The no-code tech stack remains but is instrumental to building the agents, not the product.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.soraia.io/en/pricing): three fixed-price services plus optional one-off add-ons, and hour packages for small jobs. VAT excluded. **Analysis**: €3,000 one-off, optional, deducted from the first Sprint if you start within 30 days. **Sprint**: from €8,000/month, a dedicated team (Account Manager, Project Manager and AI Engineer) designed to stay on the project month after month, but bookable for a single month with no lock-in; one release in production every month, with encryption of sensitive fields, audit logs, load testing and SLAs included. **Hypercare**: from €500/month, optional, annual contract from go-live, including a monthly test of the AI agents' answers and API cost control. One-off add-ons: Compliance & Audit €4,000, Pentest €4,000, Training and adoption €3,000, Grant support €2,000 paid only if the grant is won. **Hour packages**: 50 hours for €4,000, 100 hours for €7,500. A builder on the page composes the path and the total.

## Core Services

- [AI Agents](https://www.soraia.io/en/ai-agents): Building custom AI agents inside business processes. First release in 4 weeks. Sprint from €8,000/month (see /en/pricing).
- [AI Adoption](https://www.soraia.io/en/ai-adoption): Workshops and monthly mentoring for the team. 3 tiers: Foundation, Foundation + Mentoring, Foundation + Mentoring + Brain Pilot. 110 hours/year freed per person. Pricing on /prezzi.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://www.soraia.io/en/ai-search-optimization): Audit + content re-architecture + high-converting AI-ready website rebuild. To be found on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews. Pricing on /prezzi.
- [Custom Software](https://www.soraia.io/en/software-development): Custom web apps, mobile apps, CRMs and internal tools to digitalize and optimize processes. First release in 4 weeks, client owns the code from day one. Pricing on /prezzi.
- [Generational change, dedicated team](https://www.soraia.io/en/dedicated-team-offer): A dedicated team that modernizes obsolete business software with AI in a few weeks. First month satisfied or refunded.

## Six Ops Clusters (Use Cases)

- [Recruitment & HR](https://www.soraia.io/en/recruitment): CV screening, candidate outreach at scale, JD parsing, interview scheduling, BD on companies in hiring spikes.
- [Finance & Document Automation](https://www.soraia.io/en/finance): Bank reconciliations, PDF/invoice extraction, client onboarding, recurring reports, commission calculations.
- [Sales & Marketing Automation](https://www.soraia.io/en/sales-marketing): Lead qualification, content generation, multi-channel publishing, personalized outreach, reporting.
- [Customer & Compliance Automation](https://www.soraia.io/en/customer-support): Ticket triage, UGC moderation, GDPR/AI Act compliance, audit trail, routing to the team.
- [Real Estate Operations](https://www.soraia.io/en/real-estate): Property capture from listings, data enrichment, client-property matching, comparative dossiers, multi-stakeholder approval pipelines.
- [Event Management](https://www.soraia.io/en/event-management): Linkly SaaS dedicated to B2B trade shows. 6 AI agents for ticket/badge OCR, enrichment from 30+ sources, dynamic qualification, CRM activation, follow-up from the client's domain. Pricing on linkly.events.

## Public Case Studies

- [APraise](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/apraise): Executive search boutique, 100,000+ candidates managed by the AI agent, equivalent to 4 additional recruiters.
- [Stars Be Original](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/stars-be-original): Hospitality recruitment, 20,000+ candidates managed by the AI agent, <1 minute response time.
- [Talent Match](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/talent-match): Recruitment platform "Braint", custom ATS + CRM + AI matching.
- [Numeraria](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/numeraria): Payroll & accounting firm, AI agents for quotes/hours/reconciliations, half a month given back to management.
- [LIFTT](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/liftt): Deep tech VC holding, automated email archiving and deduplication, auto-generated monthly report.
- [ILTEC](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/iltec): B2B office technology in Biella, website rebuilt in 3 weeks AI search optimized + commercial AI agent via QR code on the machinery fleet.
- [CXL](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/cxl): Online education/marketing training, AI expert onboarding agent, 70 hours saved per expert.
- [StoryWonder](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/storywonder): Consumer mobile EdTech for kids, app live in 4 weeks, 300,000+ stories generated.
- [Navily](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/navily): Boating community, -70% operational time on moderation and enrichment.
- [Startup GovTech](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/startup-govtech): Diplomacy, AI agent for verbal notes (NDA).
- [French Riviera Househunting](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/frh): Real estate boutique on the French Riviera, 2 AI agents for qualified lead generation and property capture.
- [Rainplan](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/rainplan): Climate-tech stormwater management, hundreds of parcels and multi-stakeholder approvals handled autonomously.
- [40Factory](https://www.soraia.io/en/case-studies/40factory): Industrial IoT / Industry 4.0, Linkly for B2B trade-show lead generation, 5 AI agents for capture, enrichment, qualification, CRM activation and follow-up.

## Company

- [About us](https://www.soraia.io/en/about): A team of more than 10 people distributed across Italy, 100% remote, founded in 2023 by Daniel Levis (CEO, change management & AI adoption) and Davide Silvestri (CTO, agent development & governance). Registered office in Biella.

## How we work and guarantee

Three fixed-price services (Analysis €3,000, Sprint from €8,000/month, Hypercare from €500/month) plus one-off add-ons, and hour packages (50 hours €4,000, 100 hours €7,500) for small jobs. A Sprint Goal is signed at the start of every month and a release reaches production at the end: the client approves what goes in and reviews what comes out. Code belongs to the client from day one, no perpetual subscriptions, no lock-in. Guarantee: first month satisfied or refunded. Detail and builder at https://www.soraia.io/en/pricing.

## Compliance

- GDPR-compliant, European infrastructure when required, on-premise available
- DPA art. 28 included in the contract
- Alignment with the EU AI Act
- No LLM training on client data
- Immutable audit log on every agent decision
